# HARNESS VALIDATION FIXTURE ONLY / NOT REAL PERFORMANCE DATA

20 synthetic frames at 100 ms intervals, 14 original-order returns each: eight
static at Z=0.1 and six confirmed dynamic at Z=3.0. Distances span all four bands.
A static four-point patch gains pedestrian labels in frames 4–6, then loses them.
Dynamic points overlap static XY support, exercising exclusion during refinement,
historical replay and later coarsening. Labels and origin are synthetic. This is
neither sensor data nor accuracy, throughput or memory-savings evidence for SIH.
